authoring-kit/check.mjs: Check a pack using the same validator as Story Block.
authoring-kit/scripts/limits.mjs: Prints the host's limits for packs and data modules.
authoring-kit/scripts/sb-root.mjs: Where the kit finds Story Block's own code (the pack checker and its limits).
core/settings/defaults.js: Assembles the schema-1 settings tree from core and UI defaults and each module's declared settings.
core/settings/first-load.js: Replaces an old-shaped Story Suite settings tree on first load while stashing it untouched as storySuite_legacy.
core/settings/load.js: Puts the schema-1 settings tree in place when the runtime starts, setting an old-shaped one aside.
core/settings/schema.js: Declares the current Story Suite settings schema version.
core/settings/ui-defaults.js: Holds the UI settings defaults: only the old preview key, no longer read.
core/version.js: Holds the suite's one release number, rewritten by scripts/release.mjs with the other places that carry it.
docs/history/packages/story-block/.claud: Rebases Story Block's release branch on main, then rebuilds each module's release commit on its main.
Tests the three Story Suite repos side by side in one folder, each in turn.
examples/fishing/index.js: Story Suite Fishing: a reference activity for Story Block v2.
examples/fishing/src/module-parts/cast.j: Casting a line: choosing the spot, then opening a session whose seed decides the fish and the bite.
examples/fishing/src/module-parts/consta: The fishing module's identity and size limits.
examples/fishing/src/module-parts/defini: The module definition: the domain, commands, queries, context and the Fishing tab and widget.
examples/fishing/src/module-parts/reel.j: Ending a line: reel it in (landing or losing the fish) or put a logged catch back.
examples/fishing/src/module-parts/shared: Small helpers every command shares: asking another module, naming the angler, and making ids from a receipt.
Reading and tidying the fishing sessions: the party's stack a grant made, pruning old lines, the open line.
Views of the fishing slice: the slice itself, a plain copy of a value and the open line as the widget shows it.
examples/fishing/src/module-parts/valida: The fishing record: its starting shape and the check that finds what is damaged in it (SPEC §2.5).
examples/fishing/src/module-parts/widget: What the Fishing widget is given: its prop list, props from a layout or a tab view, and the currency.
examples/fishing/src/module.js: The `fishing-activity` module definition (SPEC §6): the `fishing` domain, the three commands, two queries and the Fishing tab.
Deciding a catch from a seed: the fish, when it bites, how long the window is and whether a press lands in it.
examples/fishing/src/rules-parts/lines.j: The sentences a cast tells: the item note and the landed, lost and released lines.
The fishing tables: the waters, the rarities, the quality grades and what bites where.
examples/fishing/src/rules-parts/tell.js: Telling a fish in words: its weight, the article before it and the phrases that name it.
examples/fishing/src/rules-parts/value.j: A value in the smallest coin as words, using the currency in play.
examples/fishing/src/rules-parts/water.j: Naming the water: which of river, lake or sea a place's words describe, and the spot made from it.
examples/fishing/src/rules.js: The fishing rules: what lives in each kind of water, how a catch is decided and how it is told.
examples/fishing/src/widget.js: The fishing mini-game as one self-contained widget: renderFishing(el, props, api).
examples/fishing/style.css: styles the Fishing example's water strip, bobber phases, actions, catch log and released or empty rows, using SillyTavern theme variables.
index.js: The one entry SillyTavern loads: hides the old view's furniture from the first paint (unless this device chose the old view), starts the host and its built-in modules, then the people part, then the view.
modules/people/core/destructive-settleme: Browser-side registry that connects the destructive-settlement controller to SillyTavern and Delta's public API.
modules/people/core/hardening.js: Applies the settings-key hardening rules in the browser: owner-qualified keys, renames and deleted chats.
modules/people/legacy/style-editor.css: Settings roster, relationship tuning, native dossier editor, archive, mobile hardening, popup editor and Megumin rules.
modules/people/settings/bucket.js: Finds the NPC State settings bucket inside the one Story Suite settings tree.
modules/rpg/game-sections.js: Turns the RPG's level cap setting into the rpg section of a game pack, and back.
modules/rpg/join-parts/add.js: Builds the join card a person's People page offers (Add to party) for someone who may join: not You, not in the party, not one who left, room for four.
modules/scene/domains/core/game-sections: Turns Story Block's money settings into the currency and economy sections of a game pack, and back.
packs/game-export.js: Builds a format 4 game pack from the sections the owners hold (checked by the game validator) and hands a game pack's sections back to their owners.
packs/import-run.js: Installs the picked pack files or the character's lorebook packs and says what happened in words; shared by the old Packs panel and the new Settings page.
scripts/checks/code-files.mjs: Classifies code and test paths and lists repo code files via git.
scripts/checks/core-module-refs.mjs: Fails if the core's turn, prompt, sdk, registry, commands, interaction or old-view host code names an RPG or fight word on a line that docs/merge/core-module-refs.txt does not list (the list only shrinks).
scripts/checks/count-lines.mjs: Counts lines in source text without adding a line for a trailing newline.
scripts/checks/css-imports.mjs: Fails when a stylesheet @import reachable from the manifest names no file.
scripts/checks/file-size.mjs: Parses the legacy-oversize list and checks file line counts against the 450-line limit.
scripts/checks/globals-gate.mjs: Fails if core/, ui/, modules/ or packs/ name a removed page global or DOM flag outside the shrink-only docs/merge/global-exceptions.txt.
scripts/checks/legacy-exports.mjs: Reads the shrink-only list of moved legacy files allowed over the export limit and rejects entries added compared with the base list.
scripts/checks/legacy-ratchet.mjs: Rejects legacy-oversize list entries that were added or raised compared with the base list, and decides which base lists are acceptable.
scripts/checks/no-tracked-deps.mjs: Fails if git tracks any file, folder or symlink whose path has a node_modules segment.
scripts/checks/nul-check.mjs: Reports a NUL byte found in a text file.
scripts/checks/one-manifest.mjs: Refuses a repo with a second manifest.json or no root one.
scripts/checks/package-scope.mjs: Checks that the root package.json is an ES module and no nested package.json exists outside packages/.
scripts/checks/removed-exports.mjs: Fails if a tracked source file uses a name from docs/merge/removed-exports.txt, the code removed in a cleanup step.
scripts/checks/run-size-check.mjs: CLI that checks repo file sizes or writes the legacy-oversize allowlist.
scripts/checks/test-command-args.mjs: Evaluates a node --test command with the shell and returns the test paths and globs it passes, without Node options.
scripts/checks/test-globs.mjs: Fails when a test file (by Node default test names) is not run by the files the root test scripts and the suite script really pass to node --test.
scripts/ci/choose-base.sh: Chooses the base commits (one per line) for the CI diff and legacy-list ratchet: every parent that has the list, with the import-commit fallback only before the list exists.
scripts/ci/farm.mjs: Makes the sibling-folder farm (Story_block, Story_director, npc_state_delta) that cross-package tests look in, from the suiteFarm list in scripts/layout.json.
scripts/temp-dir.mjs: Makes temporary folders for scripts and tests and removes them when the process ends, including on an error, Ctrl-C or kill.
scripts/ci/suite-floor.sh: Adds up the cross-package suite shards' test counts and fails when the sum is below the floor kept in suite-tests.sh.
scripts/ci/suite-tests.sh: Runs the Story Block test folders with the sibling folders present plus tests/suite and tests/people, failing on unlisted skips, extra todos or a test count below the floor.
scripts/codemap/build-map.mjs: Builds sorted codemap rows and validates jobs and export limits; a legacy package lists over-limit files as a backlog.
scripts/codemap/cli.mjs: CLI that writes or verifies docs/codemap.md and the package maps under docs/codemap/ from source files and job files.
scripts/codemap/dev-map-jobs.mjs: Reads a package's hand-written docs/dev/codemap.md bullets into package-relative job sentences.
scripts/codemap/export-names.mjs: Lists the names a file exports, expanding wildcard re-exports through internal files and reporting unresolved ones.
scripts/codemap/find-commonjs.mjs: Finds any use of the names module or exports, which are reserved because CommonJS cannot be told apart reliably.
scripts/codemap/header-job.mjs: Takes the first sentence of a file's opening comment as its job sentence.
scripts/codemap/is-facade.mjs: Decides whether a file only forwards other modules exports and so is exempt from the export limit.
scripts/codemap/package-features.mjs: Renders a package's feature entry-point index and reports entries that are not files.
scripts/codemap/package-map.mjs: Builds one package's code map: rows with tests, feature index and the one-job-per-file backlog.
scripts/codemap/package-outputs.mjs: Finds each package under packages/ and builds its map from its jobs, dev map and feature files.
scripts/codemap/parse-module.mjs: Extracts exports and import specifiers from ES module source text.
scripts/codemap/pattern-names.mjs: Lists the names a destructuring or plain binding pattern declares.
scripts/codemap/render-map.mjs: Renders codemap rows into a deterministic markdown document.
scripts/codemap/resolve-spec.mjs: Resolves a relative import specifier to a repo file path.
scripts/codemap/root-jobs.mjs: Finds job sentences for files under the source roots from package dev-map bullets and opening comments.
scripts/codemod/apply-known.mjs: Splits an apply run's stale strings, verify problems and failing moved tests into new ones and the ones a shrink-only list names.
scripts/codemod/apply.mjs: Applies a layout plan to a git tree: moves files, backs up deletes, then runs the import and string rewriters.
scripts/codemod/area-commands.mjs: Runs the apply, verify and port-branch commands for one layout area and writes a summary with an exit code.
scripts/codemod/area.mjs: Narrows a whole-layout plan and path mapper to the moves one area owns, so an area can be applied and verified alone.
scripts/codemod/baseline.mjs: Counts, per file, the relative specifiers that already resolve to nothing in a commit, so a migration is not blamed for them.
scripts/codemod/cli.mjs: Parses the layout tool's plan, apply, verify and port-branch commands and prints the per-area plan with the unmatched list.
scripts/codemod/dry-run.mjs: Runs one area's moves, rewrites, verify and moved tests in a temp worktree that is always thrown away.
scripts/codemod/known.mjs: Reads the shrink-only list of expected plan problems and splits a problem list into new, listed and stale ones.
scripts/codemod/layout-map.mjs: Maps a path through the whole layout's rules alone, so a name given as of the old layout is found after earlier areas moved it.
scripts/codemod/load-layout-rules.mjs: Reads the layout rule files of the eight areas.
scripts/codemod/plan.mjs: Turns tracked files plus rule sets into a move/delete plan and refuses unmatched files, collisions and clobbered targets.
scripts/codemod/port-branch.mjs: Ports a lane branch to the new layout in a temp worktree and merges main so only real conflicts remain.
scripts/codemod/quoted.mjs: Reads the quoted strings of one source line, skipping regex literals, so two lines compare equal when only a path differs.
scripts/codemod/rewrite-imports.mjs: Rewrites a moved file's relative import specifiers: resolved against the old place, written against the new one.
scripts/codemod/rewrite-strings.mjs: Rewrites the non-import path references (codemap keys, lists, CI globs, path literals) from an explicit table of sites.
scripts/codemod/rules.mjs: Reads codemod layout rule files and matches a path to the longest rule prefix with stem handling.
scripts/codemod/snapshot.mjs: Reads a tree's files and JS sources from the working tree or from a git ref, with no checkout.
scripts/codemod/specifiers.mjs: Finds every module specifier in a JS source with acorn and resolves a relative one against a file set.
scripts/codemod/verify-applied.mjs: Verifies an applied area: the tree judged against what already failed before the move, plus the two-commit diff.
scripts/codemod/verify.mjs: Checks a migrated tree: specifiers resolve, nothing is left at an old location, and the diff is only renames plus path edits.
scripts/core/bench-long.mjs: Story Suite v2 long-chat benchmark (docs/v2/PERFORMANCE.md, "Long chats").
scripts/core/bench-query.mjs: Query burst benchmark (docs/v2/PERFORMANCE.md, "Queries on an unchanged chat").

scripts/core/check.mjs: Syntax-checks every shipped `.js` and `.mjs` file under core, ui (except the Director folder), modules, packs, testkit, examples, scripts, authoring-kit and the NPC State folder, printing "syntax ok".

scripts/core/fuzz-replay-parts/swipes.js: The three swipe edits the fuzz makes on a reply: add one, show one, delete one.

scripts/director/check.mjs: Syntax-checks every `.js` file under `ui/legacy/director/` (the Story Director folder), printing "syntax ok".
scripts/dryrun/card-text.mjs: Renders a reply's changes card as plain text with the real template over a fake DOM, for the dry-run record.
scripts/dryrun/cli.mjs: CLI that records chat exports against a suite checkout and compares two recording folders.
scripts/dryrun/compare-cards.mjs: Lists the replies whose recorded card text differs between two dry-run recordings.
scripts/dryrun/compare-history.mjs: Lists which history-operation steps of a dry-run recording failed, so a thrown or empty step is never a pass.
scripts/dryrun/compare-records.mjs: Compares two dry-run chat recordings and reports up to 20 truncated differences.
scripts/dryrun/flags.mjs: Parses the dry-run's --flags list and sets those settings flags on the host before a chat loads.
scripts/dryrun/history-ops.mjs: Runs the seeded swipe, middle delete, rewind and reload sequence on one chat and records head hash, queries and Re-read after each.
scripts/dryrun/load-chat.mjs: Loads a SillyTavern .jsonl or .jsonl.gz chat export into header and messages.
scripts/dryrun/out-guard.mjs: Refuses a dry-run output folder inside any git checkout or non-empty, and clears only the files its manifest lists.
scripts/dryrun/prompt-capture.mjs: Runs the host's prompt build for the next reply and returns the static text and tail it sets.
scripts/dryrun/query-args.mjs: Finds real names, ids and owners in the chat state to call the id-taking queries with.
scripts/dryrun/query-steps.mjs: Finds the host's scene, inventory, director and npc queries and asks them at one reply.
scripts/dryrun/record-chat.mjs: Replays a loaded chat on the suite host to record per-reply hashes, prompts, queries, and Re-read results.
scripts/dryrun/reread-step.mjs: Loads a chat into the host, reads a reply's Changes text, and Re-reads one reply on a fresh load.
scripts/dryrun/state-hash.mjs: Stable stringify and hashing of host state so old and new runs compare by bytes.
scripts/dryrun/suite-at.mjs: Loads a module of a checkout from its old-layout path or, when that is gone, from where the layout rules put it.
scripts/dryrun/suite-host.mjs: Builds the suite host with the page's Delta runtime, a checkpoint vault and stand-in restores for exports without dossier files.
scripts/layout.mjs: Loads scripts/layout.json and answers which repo paths sit under a package root or a source root.
scripts/people/browser-stage9.py: Optional synthetic browser checks of the local UI modules using Playwright and an in-memory host.
scripts/people/measure-prompts.mjs: Builds Delta's scanner, profile, injection and narration prompts for fixed scenes and checks their sizes, without provider calls.
scripts/people/measure-stage9.mjs: Executes production builders, retry construction and both dispatcher routes with synthetic responses.
scripts/play/dist-assets.mjs: Copies the CSS, fonts and images the play bundle reaches by URL to the same path as in the source tree.
scripts/play/dist-git.mjs: Extracts a commit's source tree and commits the built play folder as a child of the previous build.
scripts/play/dist-sets.mjs: Says what the play extension contains: the one bundle set, the source folders it reads and the root manifest and build record.
scripts/play/dist.mjs: Builds the one installable play extension from a commit: bundles the root index.js, copies assets, writes root files and commits to the local play branch.
scripts/play/git.mjs: Runs git commands for the play build, with an optional private index file.
scripts/release.mjs: CLI that builds every extension's bundles and runs the release gate (--check builds into a temporary folder).
scripts/release/bundle.mjs: Packs the one extension from the repo root into a few ES-module bundles with source maps, lazy parts kept as separate chunks, host imports kept at the depth of the file that names them.
scripts/release/check.mjs: Runs the release gate: version 0.1.0, no tag, each bundle set builds, resolves its imports, keeps import.meta.url rewritten and loads in at most ten requests.
scripts/release/css.mjs: Joins the manifest stylesheet and its @imports into one file for the build, copies the fonts it names, and counts the stylesheet requests a start makes.
scripts/release/entries.mjs: Lists what the release build packs: the one entry file, index.js, and the lazy modules.
scripts/release/graph.mjs: Walks a bundle folder's import graph to list the files of the load, the lazy chunks and any missing import.
scripts/release/layout-paths.mjs: Finds a file named as of the old layout on a checkout of either layout, and the old name of a moved file, through the layout rules and a frozen list of old files.
scripts/release/outdir.mjs: Decides where the release build may write: refuses the source and the repo root, and empties only folders carrying its own marker file.
scripts/release/rewrite.mjs: Rewrites a module's source by syntax tree for the bundle: packs eager import() calls and keeps import.meta.url on the module's original location.
scripts/release/versions.mjs: Lists the places that carry the suite's version, reports the ones that disagree and rewrites them all to one number.
scripts/sync-redraw-copy.mjs: Writes the generated Story Block copy of the redraw scheduler and, with --check, fails when it drifts from ui/runtime/redraw.js.
scripts/verify-import.sh: Proves the imported package trees match the recorded source snapshots by comparing git tree hashes.
suite.css: The one stylesheet SillyTavern loads: lists the host, people and hide sheets in cascade order.

tests/people/perf-clock-stamp.test.js: Tests that NPC State reads the story clock once per task and again after a host event, counting host queries.

tests/people/store-timeline.test.js: Tests that after every reply, swipe, delete, reload, Re-read and branch Delta's cache, the store's people and the oracle rebuild agree with no publication in between.
tests/scripts/bundle-host-specifiers.tes: Pins the host import specifiers of the bundles to the recorded text, and checks the unbundled entry graph resolves each to a file the host has.
tests/scripts/ci-timeouts.test.js: Checks that every CI job has a timeout and every node --test command sets the per-test timeout and force-exit flags and matches its package script.
tests/scripts/layout.test.js: Tests the layout file, the layout-driven codemap and size scripts on today's tree.
tests/scripts/release-versions.test.js: Tests the version places: agreement on the real tree, a disagreeing place named, the release gate failing on it, and a rewrite touching only the version lines.
tests/suite/nsd-static-part.js: Writes NPC State Delta's own one-pass static prompt key the way its runtime injection does, and switches its adapter on or off for the suite test.

ui/contract/story.js: Defines the view-model shape for the Story tab (Director screen and trackers).
ui/contract/world.js: Defines the view-model shape for the World tab (places, routes, trip, news, factions).

ui/css/base.css: Base styles: reset, font and focus rules for everything inside the suite root.

ui/css/dossier.css: Styles for the dossier: top bar, hero ring, summary cards, pager and the page bodies; tokens plus the mock's sky and fixed colours, sized from the container.
ui/css/fight.css: Styles for the Fight tab: header, foes, party, action tiles, log and end card; tokens only, sized from the container.
ui/css/journal.css: Styles for the Journal tab: quest cards, leads, closed list, calendar, day panel, coming up and the edit form; tokens, plus the mock's fixed tints and text colours in both themes.
ui/css/kit.css: Kit styles: the one button, chip, switch and segmented-control family, sized for touch.
ui/css/next-hide.css: Hides the old Story Suite furniture (chat furniture, the wand menu entry, the drawer's buttons and strip switch) only while the body carries ss-ui-next.
ui/css/now.css: Styles for the Now tab cards, the Show-all list, the spoiler switch and the feelings ring; tokens, plus the mock's fixed late, fight, torn, ring and tracker-bar tones and its per-scheme feeling colours.

ui/css/people.css: Styles for the People tab: tiles, filters, search and the cast map; tokens plus the mock's fixed disc and legend colours.
ui/css/settings.css: Settings overlay styles: frame, section nav, rows and controls, search, footer meter (decision 33; tokens renamed --g-* to --su-*).

ui/css/story.css: Styles for the Story tab: plan bar, Director cards, agendas, secrets, ripples and trackers; tokens, plus the mock's fixed spoiler-button amber and white switch thumb.
ui/css/world.css: Styles for the World tab: switch, map, trip card, place sheet, news and factions; tokens only, sized from the container.
ui/dev/harness.html: Dev harness page: the plain HTML shell that loads the suite UI on the fake port for local viewing and the rendered checks.

ui/dev/portraits.js: Dev harness only: puts the mock's portrait photos on data-portrait elements, keeping the letter circle as the fallback.
ui/entry/drawer-buttons.js: Adds the new view's Settings and Open Story Suite buttons to the Story Suite drawer in SillyTavern's Extensions panel.

ui/fixtures/bag.js: Builds the shared Bag fixture: items, purse, load, party pace and assets (default, story-only, over the limit).
ui/fixtures/dossier.js: Shared dossier fixtures (alive, away, deceased, presumed with unknown gender) plus the cast ties for People > Map.
ui/fixtures/fight.js: Builds the shared Fight fixture: the Auvoth bridge fight in each board state (offer, choose, target, ally, after, end).

ui/fixtures/journal.js: Builds the Journal tab fixture (quests, leads, closed, calendar, days, coming up) from the shared moment.

ui/fixtures/settings-extra.js: Settings fixture data beyond plain rows: module definitions, presets, the removed list, packs, trackers and the "what's sent" breakdown.

ui/fixtures/story.js: Builds the Story tab fixture (plan switch, pulse, arc, agendas, cast, secrets, ripples, trackers) from the shared moment.
ui/fixtures/world.js: Shared world fixtures (map, trip, news, factions) with variants: default, fightOpen (on the road), empty.
ui/index.js: Public face of the new Story Suite view: re-exports the mount function, the port contract and the fake port.
ui/kit/bars.js: Draws the three equal Health, Mana and Stamina bars and the thin EXP bar of the character card.
ui/kit/controls.js: Provides the suite's single control family: button, chip, switch toggle and segmented control.
ui/kit/dom.js: Builds DOM and SVG elements from tag names, attributes and children using text nodes only.

ui/kit/more.js: Shows the first few rows of a list and a "Show all N" / "Show fewer" button for the rest.
ui/kit/page.js: Builds the pager bar for a multi-page screen, plus the page section and label-value list that page bodies share.
ui/kit/ring.js: Draws the feelings ring: four quarter arcs (trust, affection, desire, tension) sized by each meter, none for zero.

ui/kit/sheet.js: Opens the shared bottom sheet (dim backdrop, grab bar, optional title row) that closes by backdrop, Escape or its close button.
ui/kit/spoiler.js: Builds the spoiler switch row and the hidden-until-shown text used for scene secrets.
ui/mount.js: Mounts the suite on a port: builds the shell and tab host, wires back-stack and redraw, and returns open, close, settings and destroy.
ui/port/aliases.js: The new view's command names that the engine registers under another name or as one dm.set: Quiet scene, End this arc and Spend points.
ui/port/contract.js: Defines the UI-to-engine port method contract and validates port implementations.
ui/port/fake-port.js: Fake engine port that serves fixture view-models, records commands, and emits events on demand.
ui/port/focus.js: Answers quest.focus by keeping the Journal's focus pick in the chat's view prefs.

ui/port/prefs-key.js: Names the chat-metadata key that holds this chat's view prefs.
ui/port/rpg.js: Answers the RPG and fights page's settings commands: each row writes the key the old view's page writes, with the same clamps.
ui/port/sb-port.js: Wraps Story Block's sdk as the UI port: views come from injected selectors fed by sdk queries, actions pass through, and nothing throws.
ui/port/settings-director.js: Stores a Director page change in the same module setting the old view's page writes.
ui/port/st-chat.js: Touches SillyTavern's page: finds message elements, adds the Extensions-menu entry, fills the input, and keeps prefs in chat metadata.
ui/port/trackers.js: The Story › Trackers commands for the port: Show on Now, a value changed by hand, remove, and adding a tracker from a template.
ui/runtime/back-stack.js: Manages the Escape and back stack in order: menu, sheet, page, settings, suite, chat.
ui/runtime/can.js: Says whether a control that sends a command should be drawn: false only when the port has nobody to answer it.
ui/runtime/prefs.js: Stores fold state per device and spoiler levels per chat through the port.
ui/runtime/redraw.js: Coalesces change events into one frame and redraws only changed sections, reading none but the chat's while the suite is closed.
ui/select/bag.js: Turns the recorded inventory, gear, wallet and mount query answers into the Bag view-model (BAG_SHAPE), leaving gaps null.
ui/select/build.js: Builds the per-tab selector map for the Story Block port from the gathered answers.
ui/select/card.js: Builds the character-card view-model from recorded query answers; gaps come back as null.
ui/select/chat.js: Builds the chat view-models (inline row, people drawer, reply menu lines) from recorded query answers; gaps come back as null or [].
ui/select/director-rows.js: Lists the Director settings page's rows: which module setting each is, its group and the words the mock gives it.
ui/select/dossier.js: Turns the stored dossier, meters, ladder and notes query answers into one person's Dossier view-model (DOSSIER_SHAPE), with ties linked and Likes filled, leaving gaps null or empty.
ui/select/fight.js: Turns the recorded fight-board snapshot, party and choice lists into the Fight view-model (FIGHT_SHAPE), leaving gaps null.
ui/select/focus.js: Reads the quest the reader picked as the focus from the chat's prefs and builds its Today › focus line while it is open.
ui/select/gather.js: Reads the scene answers, portraits and gear from Story Block queries for the selectors.
ui/select/journal.js: Turns recorded Director query answers into the Journal tab view-model (gaps come back null, empty or zero).
ui/select/money.js: Words an amount of the chat's one currency ("5 marks", "3 silver 5 pennies") for the Bag purse and the Journal's day money.
ui/select/now.js: Builds the Now-tab view-model from recorded query answers; gaps come back as null or empty lists.
ui/select/offers.js: Turns the card-offer controller's offers into the plain rows the new view draws and counts the waiting ones.
ui/select/packs.js: Builds Settings › Packs and trackers from the installed packs and the data-module setup.
ui/select/party.js: Turns the recorded party and gear query answers into the Party view-model (PARTY_SHAPE), leaving gaps null.
ui/select/people-parts.js: Reads the People tab's parts and the per-person dossier map from the store's people queries.
ui/select/people-settings/feel.js: Lists the People page's Feelings, Pacing, Stages, Pull and drift and Who gets a dossier rows from mock v7.
ui/select/people-settings/index.js: Reads the People rows from the stored NPC State settings and looks a row up by key for a write or a reset.
ui/select/people-settings/kit-more.js: Builds a People row of named numbers or a shown-only row, and holds the whole-number clamp the old panel's boxes use.
ui/select/people-settings/kit.js: Builds a People settings row for a number, a switch or a choice: its NPC State setting, how it reads and how a change is cut and stored.
ui/select/people-settings/run.js: Lists the People page's Refresh and the narrator, Portraits and Map rows from mock v7.
ui/select/people.js: Turns the store's people rows, the key-people and party answers and the social graph into the People view-model (PEOPLE_SHAPE), leaving gaps null or empty.
ui/select/purse-lines.js: Turns the head reply's coin lines (reply.changes) into the Bag purse's this-turn list.
ui/select/rpg-rows.js: Builds the RPG and fights page's rows from Story Block's settings bucket, with the same keys and readers the old view's page uses.
ui/select/settings-director.js: Builds the Settings Director section from the live module settings, leaving out a row whose feature is off.
ui/select/settings.js: Builds the Settings view-model from today's host settings (schema, defaults, stored values) and the feature list; gaps come back empty or null.
ui/select/story.js: Turns recorded Director and data-module query answers into the Story tab view-model (gaps come back null, empty or false).
ui/select/tie-kinds.js: Reads a social-graph edge's relation text as one of the four tie kinds the People map draws.
ui/select/world.js: Builds the World view-model from recorded atlas.view, world.areaTier, atlas.selected and director.world answers (pure).
ui/settings/connections.js: Renders the Models page's three connection cards (Story, Quick helpers, Background) and the "Who goes first" note.
ui/settings/fields.js: Renders one settings schema row (label, hint, marks and the control for its type) and groups rows into cards.
ui/settings/game-export.js: Draws the Tools page's Game pack card and saves the exported game pack file through the page's download link.
ui/settings/modules.js: Renders the Start page's module area: the scope switch, the three presets and the module cards with their features.
ui/settings/nav.js: Builds the section navigation: a side list with search and group labels, and the phone section list with the same search.
ui/settings/overlay.js: Builds the Settings overlay frame: header, section nav, the section or search page, the "what's sent" footer, and its back-stack entry.
ui/settings/packs.js: Renders the Packs and trackers page: installed packs with a remove confirmation, data modules and this chat's trackers.
ui/settings/page.js: Composes one Settings section page: heading, the "applies to" note, the module card, the special body, the setting cards and the reset buttons.
ui/settings/search.js: Finds settings rows by words across label, hint, unit, group and section name, and renders the hits under "Section › Group".
ui/settings/sections/director.js: Renders the Director section through the hook: the overlay's body for it, unchanged.
ui/settings/sections/index.js: Maps each settings section id to its hook renderer; sections with no entry get the overlay's default body.
ui/settings/sections/look.js: Renders the Look section: the overlay's body plus a note on what Follow SillyTavern does.
ui/settings/sections/money-extras.js: Renders the Money and Chat extras sections through the hook: the overlay's body for each, unchanged.
ui/settings/sections/people.js: Renders the People section through the hook: the overlay's body for it, unchanged.
ui/settings/sections/rpg.js: Renders the RPG and fights section: the overlay's body plus the Custom-difficulty pointer to Director.
ui/settings/sections/start.js: Frames a hook page: the overlay's body for a section with the hook's own notes before or after it.
ui/settings/sections/world.js: Renders the World and time section through the hook: the overlay's body for it, unchanged.
ui/settings/developer.js: The Tools page's developer card: a per-device switch for module authors, and with it on Use the old view (the hidden fallback) and the Template page (the generic activity view on a sample).
ui/settings/sent.js: Renders the Tools page's "What is sent each reply" card (budget bars and the text sent) and the Inspector and problems card.
ui/sheets/scene-sheet.js: Builds the Scene sheet (date, time, place, weather, who is here) as one hand correction, and opens it in a sheet.
ui/shell/default-views.js: Supplies the default card and tab renderers for mountSuite: the character card, the Now tab, and a "not built yet" card.
ui/shell/suite-view.js: Builds the suite root that slides in over the chat, sized from its container and centred over a dimmed chat on desktop.
ui/shell/tab-host.js: Builds the 8-tab host: tablet strip, phone bottom bar, scrolling panel and the mini bar shown after the card scrolls away.
ui/shell/tab-views.js: Builds the renderer for every built tab (Party, Bag, Fight, People, World, Journal, Story) from a view-model and a shared context.
ui/tabs/bag/assets.js: Builds the Assets card (party pace, Transport and Property lists, folded by default) and the asset detail sheet.
ui/tabs/bag/bag.js: Composes the Bag tab: Purse with party load and Assets side by side when wide, then the Items card.

ui/tabs/journal/day.js: Builds the day panel for one calendar day: a past day's record, today's plan, or what is due on a later day.
ui/tabs/journal/journal.js: Composes the Journal tab: a Quests (Tasks) / Calendar switch, then that view's cards with empty cards left out.
ui/tabs/journal/quest-editor.js: Opens the quest editor in a sheet and sends the changed fields (or give up, or delete) to the port.

ui/tabs/journal/quests.js: Builds the Quests (Tasks when RPG is off), Leads and Closed cards with focus star and Edit button on each quest.
ui/tabs/now/card-offer.js: Draws the card's pack offers inside the Needs you card: Install or Update with the Also apply tick, Not now and Dismiss.
ui/tabs/now/here.js: Builds the Here card: people present with their feelings ring and the Scene spoiler for wants and hiding.
ui/tabs/now/now.js: Composes the Now tab in phone order: Right now, Here, This turn, You, Pinned; two columns when the container is wide.
ui/tabs/now/right-now.js: Builds the two "Right now" cards: Needs you (actions only) and Today (focus, trip, due soon, torn gear).
ui/tabs/now/this-turn.js: Builds the This reply card: what the reply changed, exceptions first, five rows then Show all, with Why on held-back lines.
ui/tabs/now/you-pinned.js: Builds the folded You card (look, position, condition) and the pinned tracker cards.
ui/tabs/party/party.js: Composes the Party tab: the row of member portraits with Invite and, while the story has no You, New character; then the selected member's sheet.

ui/tabs/people/dossier/feelings.js: Draws the dossier hero ring with its four corner numbers and builds the "With you" page (meters, stage, changes).
ui/tabs/people/dossier/mood-meters.js: Builds the three Mood meters (Feeling, Energy, Control on a -3..+3 scale) from the dossier moodBars.

ui/tabs/people/dossier/party-add.js: Builds the Add to party button on a person's page and the join card it opens (Add to party, Edit first, Not now).

ui/tabs/people/dossier/tie-disc.js: Builds a tie's round portrait (image, person glyph or initial letter) for the dossier Ties card and page.
ui/tabs/people/map.js: Draws People > Map: everyone known placed around you by a feeling lens, tie lines between them and a card for the picked person.
ui/tabs/people/people.js: Composes the People tab: header with List/Map switch, search, filters, the Here / Elsewhere / Deceased lists, or the cast map.
ui/tabs/people/person-card.js: Builds one person tile for the People list (feelings ring, mood, where or last seen, last said) and the portrait disc the map reuses.

scripts/b4/unit.mjs: Runs the per-unit removal recipe in order: backup, git rm, dead exports, git grep, shrink-only lists, code map, touched tests.
studio/index.html: The Pack Studio page: the suite's own stylesheets (World tab's too) and the Studio's with its four slot sheets, the full-window frame and the module entry.
studio/model/doc.js: Is the Pack Studio's document: the author's text until the first edit, the parsed pack in its own key order, the portraits, all frozen.
studio/model/history.js: Keeps undo and redo over the Pack Studio's frozen document snapshots, with a depth limit.
studio/model/edits.js: Applies the Pack Studio's four edits (set, insert, remove, move) and the portrait step to a document, all or nothing, or refuses with a reason.
studio/form/list.js: Draws the Studio's editable chip list: removable pills and a box that adds a trimmed, new value on Enter or blur.
studio/form/records.js: Draws the Studio's sub-record group: rows with move up, move down and remove, a count and an add button.
studio/form/pick.js: Opens the Studio's id picker sheet: a search box over a list of records, where a used row is shown but cannot be picked.
studio/form/gate.js: Draws the Studio's gate text box and checks it with the game's gate rules on every keystroke, showing the first problem.
tests/ui/studio/form-lists.test.js: Tests the chip list, sub-record list, id picker and gate field: adds, removals, moves, filtering, disabled rows and the gate problem line.
studio/form/fields.js: Draws a Studio form row for text, long text, number, select, toggle or segmented input, with an inline problem line under it.
tests/ui/studio/form-fields.test.js: Tests that each field row reports its edit, keeps line breaks, ignores bad numbers and shows, replaces and clears its problem line.
studio/model/seed-preview.js: Shows what NPC State seeds for one world cast entry, by running the game's own cast seeding on it, and lists the fields it fills.
studio/model/gate.js: Reads a hidden gate into or-groups of and-terms, writes it back, and checks it with the game's own gate rules against a pack's content.
studio/model/refs.js: Indexes the ids a pack defines and every place that names one (fields, one-line strings, object keys, gates), by id or by name, for Used by, pickers and rename.
studio/model/rename.js: Gives the set patches that rewrite an id's definition and every reference written as that id, or a refusal in words.
studio/draft.js: Keeps the Studio's autosaved drafts in IndexedDB, one slot per kind and id, and turns every storage failure into a message.
studio/dryrun/run.js: Runs the world engine's daily step on the author's pack for a seed, tempo and number of days, in a Worker that can be cancelled.
studio/dryrun/worker.js: Is the dry run's Worker: runs the simulation off the page and reports progress, the result or the error.
studio/main.js: Starts the Pack Studio on the page's #studio root and leaves its handle on the page for checks.
studio/studio.css: Pack Studio page styles: fonts, the full-window frame, the record cards, the header's Undo and Redo, the JSON row and the restore prompt; the rest is ui/css as it is.
studio/app.js: Runs the Pack Studio: theme, frame, the open world and game packs (one active, each an editing session), and what Open, the parts, search, Problems, Go to, Export, Undo, Redo, the draft prompt and the keys do, drawing parts through the slot tables with the editing context.
studio/shell.js: Builds the Pack Studio frame in the Settings overlay's look: header with Undo, Redo, Open, Export and theme, the note saying why Export is off, the parts nav or phone list grouped Pack, World, Game and Check, one page, the pack-check bar.
studio/keys.js: The Pack Studio keyboard: open, export, undo, redo (left to a text box while typing), search, a part by number, the next problem, back.
studio/parts.js: The Pack Studio's parts: order, names and groups, which content key each part shows per pack kind, a pack's kind, and which part a checker problem's path belongs to.
studio/load.js: Opens what the author picked (a pack zip through packs/bundle.js, or pack.json with its portraits and game.json) as the text, the parsed pack, the images and the game pack.
studio/check.js: Checks the pack text with the game's own packs/validate.js and files each problem under its Pack Studio part, record and field.
studio/pairing.js: Checks the open world and game packs with the game checker, then runs checkPairing, or names the pack that has problems first.
tests/packs/studio/pairing.test.js: Tests that pairing runs only on passing packs, uses the Built-in game by default and points each entry at the pack to open.
tests/packs/studio/model-refs.test.js: Tests the reference index on a small pack with every kind of site and on Ersveil, including names, the other pack's name cultures and garbage.
tests/packs/studio/model-rename.test.js: Tests rename: patches apply cleanly, leave nothing behind, keep key order and spacing, refuse in words, and sweep every id of every kind in Ersveil.
tests/packs/studio/refs-pack.js: Is a small world pack that uses every kind of reference site, for the Studio's reference and rename tests.
studio/export.js: What the Pack Studio exports: the world's zip (pack.json, the open game as game.json, the portraits the cast names) or one pack's pack.json, as written until an edit and as 2-space JSON after; and why Export is off while there are errors.
studio/zip-write.js: Writes a stored zip in the browser or node with the example-zip script's exact layout, for the Pack Studio's export.
studio/views/value.js: Draws one value, one labelled field and one record card for the Pack Studio's read-only views.
studio/views/records.js: Draws one Pack Studio section, one card per record, each ending in its JSON row when the pack can be edited; the editor slots draw it until their forms exist.
studio/views/overview.js: Draws the Pack Studio's Overview page: the mounted cards, the check result in words, the pack's fields, each part's counts and the other open pack.
studio/views/problems.js: Draws the Pack Studio's Problems page: the pack checker's problems grouped by part, each with Go to the record and field.
studio/views/search.js: Finds and draws the records of the open pack whose title, id, name, keys or aliases hold the searched words.
studio/css/edit.css: Pack Studio stylesheet slot for the editor forms; empty until the form jobs add their rows.
studio/css/graph.css: Pack Studio stylesheet slot for the event graph page; empty until the graph is drawn.
studio/css/map.css: Pack Studio stylesheet slot for the map page; empty until the map is drawn.
studio/css/timeline.css: Styles the Pack Studio dry-run page: the timeline's day rows and tags, the condition hold bars and the power and score curves.
studio/edit/cast.js: Pack Studio editor slot for the cast section; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/conditions.js: Pack Studio conditions form: one card per condition with its fields, effects, the used-by lines and a rename that follows every use.
studio/edit/events.js: Pack Studio editor slot for the world events section (and a format 3 pack's dated events); a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/game-calendar.js: Pack Studio editor slot for a game pack's calendar; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/game-money.js: Pack Studio editor slot for a game pack's currency and economy; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/game-names.js: Pack Studio editor slot for a game pack's name cultures; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/game-rules.js: Pack Studio editor slot for a game pack's you, rpg and pacing sections; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/game-start.js: Pack Studio editor slot for a game pack's player start; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/game-trackers.js: Pack Studio editor slot for a game pack's meter presets and data modules; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/game-weather.js: Pack Studio editor slot for a game pack's weather; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/items.js: Pack Studio items and foes editor: a searchable list of each and one record's page with its fields, local checks, duplicate, delete and the JSON row.
studio/edit/kinds.js: Pack Studio editor slot for the place kinds, route kinds and markets sections; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/lore.js: Pack Studio editor slot for the lore section; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/overview.js: Pack Studio editor slot for the Overview fields; a stub that draws each field read-only until the Overview form exists.
studio/edit/places.js: Draws the Studio's places editor: a searchable list of places and one place's record page with its pickers, chips, id rename and JSON row.
studio/edit/powers.js: Pack Studio editor slot for the powers and scores sections; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/regions.js: Pack Studio editor slot for the regions and realms sections; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/routes.js: Pack Studio editor slot for the routes section; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/start.js: Pack Studio editor slot for the world pack's starting world; a stub that draws the read-only cards until its form exists.
studio/edit/templates.js: Pack Studio templates editor: the list with find and filters, one template's record page, the open-template menu with delta ranges, rename, used-by and delete.
studio/views/convert.js: Pack Studio page slot for Convert: the card at the top of a format 3 pack's Overview saying it opens read-only.
studio/views/graph.js: Pack Studio page slot for the event graph (a List · Graph segment on Events); a stub that draws nothing, so the segment stays hidden.
studio/views/map.js: Pack Studio page slot for the map (a List · Map segment on Places & routes); a stub that draws nothing, so the segment stays hidden.
studio/views/pairing.js: Pack Studio Pairing page: the world against the open game pack or the Built-in game, the pair's problems, warnings and notes with Go to into either pack, and what holds the pair back.
studio/views/route.js: The Pack Studio's slot tables: which editor file draws each content key per pack kind, which page file mounts where, and drawing a section or a page through them.
studio/views/start.js: Pack Studio page slot for the start page shown before a pack is open: the Open button.
studio/views/timeline.js: Pack Studio Dry run page: the seed, tempo and days form, the run in a Worker, and its timeline by day, condition holds, power and score curves and the cast's moves and deaths, with Go to.
modules/rpg/view/wizard-data-parts/creat: The New character wizard's Create without a DOM: the old Review step's commands in its order (two defines, the fight blocks, an imported file's things and money), for the new view's sheet.
ui/css/wizard.css: New character wizard and first-send hold styles: the layout the sheets add to the Party sheet parts, the .ef fields and the kit buttons, in the mock's tokens.
ui/dev/wizard-demo.js: Dev harness only: draws the New character sheet on a step, the first-send hold or the empty Party tab on the fake port.
ui/wizard/attach.js: Puts the New character wizard and the first-send hold on the new view: answers the port's open of story-block/new-character itself and closes both sheets on a chat change.
ui/wizard/hold.js: Holds the first Send of a chat with the RPG on and no You in the new view: the 'Make your character first' sheet and its two answers.
ui/wizard/review.js: Draws the wizard's Review step in the new view and runs Create through modules/rpg's create-run.
ui/wizard/skills.js: Draws the wizard's Skills step in the new view: the starting sets and one card of fields per skill.
ui/wizard/stats.js: Draws the wizard's Stats step in the new view: the stat sheet's − / + rows under the creation budget, Reset and the notes.
ui/wizard/who.js: Draws the wizard's Who step in the new view: saved-character import and undo, the name and the starting level.
ui/wizard/wizard.js: The new view's New character sheet: the session, the Who · Stats · Skills · Review tabs, the summary row and Back / Next.
ui/wizard/world.js: What the new view's wizard reads from the story through the sdk and SillyTavern's context: head state, persona, reply key, rules, levels, and whether the story has You.
modules/world/chronicle/world-daily/open: World events, generated arcs: the model-facing wording for a slot that may start an arc, sent only when a slot of the batch allows one.
modules/world/daily/arc-day.js: World events, generated arcs: starts an arc from its checked plan and fires its steps and ending on their windows, under the major caps.
modules/world/daily/arc-plan.js: World events, generated arcs: checks an open answer with an arc plan as a whole (step count, menu, guards, windows) and returns the one canon plan.
modules/world/daily/pair-lapse.js: World events, the daily step: Lapses, on a chat's first step, the events whose date or season the chat's calendar lacks, and leaves such templates out.
tests/modules/world/open/arc-replay.test: Tests: generated arcs on the host (plan asked once and stored whole, replay equals live through swipe, Re-read, delete, reload, rewind).
tests/modules/world/open/arc-step.test.j: Tests: generated arcs in the daily step (plan copy, schedule, anchors, refusals, caps, template with no arc unchanged).
packs/limits-parts/game-calendar.js: Pack format 4: the fields and limits of a game pack's calendar (leap years, week, seasons).
packs/limits-parts/game-weather.js: Pack format 4: the weather styles, table fields and limits of a game pack.
packs/limits-parts/game-start.js: Pack format 4: the fields and limits of a game pack's start (money, items) and pacing (tempo).
packs/limits-parts/game-rpg.js: Pack format 4: the fields of a game pack's rpg section and the pull tuning limits.
packs/validate/game-parts/seasons.js: Checks a game pack's calendar seasons against the calendar's own months.
packs/validate/game-parts/calendar.js: Checks a game pack's calendar: the format 3 months, era and holidays check, plus leap years, week and seasons.
packs/validate/game-parts/weather.js: Checks a game pack's weather: the style and tables keyed by climate and season.
packs/validate/game-parts/start.js: Checks a game pack's start (money and items) and pacing (tempo).
packs/validate/game-parts/rpg.js: Checks a game pack's rpg section: the format 3 checks, the pull tuning and the player rank's module inside the pack.
packs/validate/game-parts/run.js: Runs the game pack's own section checks in order and collects what they keep.
tests/packs/format4-game.test.js: Tests the format 4 game validator: calendar and seasons, weather by climate, start, pacing, rpg.pull and the player rank module.
packs/validate-parts/pairing.js: Checks a world pack against a game pack's calendar, seasons and names (the pairing check) and names each part to switch off.
tests/packs/pairing.test.js: Tests the pairing check: start date, date and season anchors, birthdays, culture regions and the recommended-game info line.
packs/selection.js: Decides which installed packs a chat reads: enabled format 3 packs, the selected world and game, and the trackers of every other game pack.
packs/content-parts/start-v4.js: Puts a format 4 world's place and world state, and a game's money and items, into the shape the start merge reads.
tests/packs/selection.test.js: Tests the store's kind, the selected world and game, the trackers of every game pack, the start and the calendar start, and format 3 left as it was.
core/runtime/frame.js: Builds the part that records a chat's frame (the world and game it began with, and the game's calendar and currency) in a deferred domain, written by a beforeGenerate step.
core/runtime/frame-parts/shape.js: Defines the chat frame's slice: its starting value, the check of a frame, and the validator of the domain.
core/runtime/frame-parts/resolve.js: Reads the frame a chat would begin with from the selected world and game, and the note that a pack changed since the chat began.
core/runtime/frame-parts/commands.js: Holds the frame's commands: write it, mark its update note given, and ask the next reply to write it again.
tests/core/frame.helpers.js: Gives the frame tests a host with a world and game selected and the games to swap in.
tests/core/frame.test.js: Tests that the frame is written once and a swapped game does not move it, through swipes, a swipe back, an edited Re-read, a middle delete, a rewind and a reload.
tests/core/frame-act.test.js: Tests the act that writes the frame again, a chat change, the update note, hostile frames and a chat with nothing selected.
studio/session.js: Is one open pack's Pack Studio editing session: commit through the pure edits into frozen snapshots and undo history, a debounced check of the present snapshot, the draft save, undo, redo and restoring a draft.
studio/views/json-row.js: Draws a record's JSON row in the Pack Studio: the record as JSON read as you type, Apply as one undo step, Undo changes, the checker's word on it, and the caret at a Go to field.
tests/packs/studio/wire.test.js: Tests the Studio's edit loop without a page: commit, debounce, draft save, undo and redo, no-op edits, format 3 refusals, restore, export bytes before and after an edit, the export block, field paths and the undo keys.
tests/ui/studio/timeline.test.js: Tests the Dry run page: the form, a run in the page and in a Worker, progress, Cancel and a crash, the timeline with Go to, holds, curves, the cast and a stale run.
tests/ui/studio/pairing.test.js: Tests the Pairing page: Check against, the result line, the lists with Go to into either pack, the waiting state, Open a game pack and a format 3 world.
tests/ui/studio/edit-places.test.js: Tests the places editor: the list and find box, a record page, edits as patches, the id rename, the pickers, the climate list and the read-only fallback.
tests/ui/studio/edit-templates.test.js: Tests the templates editor: the list and filters, edits as patches, odds chips, delta ranges, menu picks and pickers, open and arc, rename, used-by, delete and the read-only fallback.
tests/ui/studio/edit-loop.test.js: Tests the Studio's edit loop in Chromium: a JSON row edit, Undo and Redo, the draft offered after a reload, Export off on errors with F8 and Go to at the field, warnings, and each pack's own history and export.
